description: Checks a CodeWiki Work Unit Candidate for exact Project Server boundary realization.
requirement: The exact Candidate must preserve one authoritative Project Server, external private state, qualified Runtime and DSH containment, protected Check judgment, canonical Knowledge ownership, and repository footprint rules, with source, tests, and Evidence aligned to every assigned obligation.

failure.message: Candidate violates or fails to prove a CodeWiki Project Server realization boundary.
remediation: Repair the Candidate under the existing Work Unit; use explicit rollover or migration when required.
